pageContent.markdown:
Silverstone Circuit, Northamptonshire

# Hilton Garden Inn Silverstone

Main wallcoverings contractor for the only hotel on the Silverstone Circuit, its rooms finished to one standard in time for the 2022 British Grand Prix.

![Hilton Garden Inn Silverstone from outside: a six-storey hotel clad in grey and buff panels, with V-shaped columns along the entrance.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/hilton-garden-inn-silverstone-press-01.jpg)

Hilton Garden Inn Silverstone from outside. Venue photograph, not our work. Photograph: Hilton.

## Project record

## At a glance

- **Client / brand:** Hilton Garden Inn Silverstone (Hilton)
- **Location:** Hamilton Straight, Silverstone Circuit, Northamptonshire
- **Year:** 2022 (completed in time for the British Grand Prix)
- **Role:** Main wallcoverings contractor
- **Scope:** Wallcovering installation

## The building

Silverstone is the home of the British Grand Prix, and Hilton Garden Inn Silverstone is the only trackside hotel on the circuit. The new six-storey hotel overlooks the start-finish line on the Hamilton Straight, with track-facing rooms, a rooftop terrace and a footbridge spanning the circuit to the hospitality building opposite. It opened in time for the 2022 British Grand Prix, and in July 2023 Hilton celebrated its debut with a rooftop party during the race weekend, held with its long-standing partner McLaren Racing.

The 197 bedrooms are contemporary and calm: pale walls, warm timber, and generous glazing that frames the circuit itself. Above them, The Rooftop offers 360-degree views of the racetrack and beyond, while BOX Bar & Kitchen serves guests throughout the day. Bicester Village and the Silverstone Museum are close at hand.

## The brief

To act as main wallcoverings contractor on a new-build, 197-room hotel due to open in time for the British Grand Prix, where a consistent, crisp finish has to repeat room after room and floor after floor.

## Our approach

**Preparation and priming.** New-build walls bring their own challenges. Surfaces were prepared and primed so that every room offered the same sound, even base, which is the foundation of consistency at scale.

**Setting out.** In a hotel built from repeated room types, setting out becomes a system. Each layout was established so that seams fell consistently in the same discreet positions around headboards, joinery and windows.

**Consistency at scale.** Batches and shading were managed across the full run of rooms so that a guest moving between floors would never notice a difference. In a building of this kind, quality is measured less by any single wall than by the hundredth room matching the first.

**Coordination.** As main wallcoverings contractor we sequenced our work with the main contractor and the other trades, so that rooms could be handed over cleanly.

## Outcome

A trackside hotel that opened in time for the 2022 British Grand Prix, its rooms finished to one consistent standard. Wallcovering on this scale is rarely noticed when it is done well, and that is precisely the point.

## Photographs on this page

These are photographs of the hotel and the circuit by other photographers, credited below. They show the venue, not our work.

- Hilton Garden Inn Silverstone from outside: photograph published by Hilton in its [July 2023 press release](https://stories.hilton.com/emea/releases/hilton-garden-inn-silverstone-debuts-on-the-famous-racetrack).
- A guest room: photograph published by Hilton in its [July 2023 press release](https://stories.hilton.com/emea/releases/hilton-garden-inn-silverstone-debuts-on-the-famous-racetrack).
- The circuit during the 2022 British Grand Prix: photograph by fuji.tim, [CC BY-SA 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0), via [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ferrari%27s_Charles_Leclerc_battles_for_the_podium_with_Mercedes%27_Lewis_Hamilton_at_the_2022_British_Grand_Prix_at_Silverstone._(52196620083).jpg). Resized for the web.
- A car on the circuit during the 2022 British Grand Prix weekend: photograph by Jen Ross, [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0), via [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:2022_British_Grand_Prix_(52382657159).jpg). Resized for the web.

## Photographs

![A guest room at Hilton Garden Inn Silverstone, with pale walls, a white bed and a glazed balcony door looking out towards the circuit.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/hilton-garden-inn-silverstone-press-02.jpg)

A guest room as published by Hilton. Venue photograph, not our work. Photograph: Hilton.

![A Ferrari and a Mercedes side by side on track at the 2022 British Grand Prix, Silverstone.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/silverstone-circuit-commons-01.jpg)

The circuit during the 2022 British Grand Prix. Venue photograph, not our work. Photograph: fuji.tim / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0).

![A single-seater racing car at speed on the Silverstone circuit during the 2022 British Grand Prix weekend.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/silverstone-circuit-commons-02.jpg)

A car on the circuit during the 2022 British Grand Prix weekend. Venue photograph, not our work. Photograph: Jen Ross / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0).

How the commission ran

## The same standards, on every commission.

Each commission has a written scope by room, walls prepared until they are true, protected floors, batch and shade control, set-out from the room’s focal points, and a return visit. [Read the method](https://www.mrwallcover.com/practice/#method).

The six standards in full

01

### Survey and scope, room by room

We measure the wall that will actually be hung, allow for the repeat and the wastage, and write a scope of works room by room before anyone orders paper.

02

### Preparation decides the finish

Walls are filled, made good and primed until they are true. If a wall is not ready for the material specified, we say so before the last drop is ordered.

03

### Protection and containment

Floors, furniture and finished joinery are protected as part of the hang. Work is contained and the place is left tidy each evening. In a home we are visitors; in a hotel we work around the house.

04

### Batch and shade control

Deliveries are checked against the measure, and batches and shading are managed so that a corridor of rooms reads as one surface.

05

### Set out from the room's focal points

Pattern is set out from chimneypieces, doorcases and bed walls, so the pattern sits square to the cornice and the joinery.

06

### One team, then the return visit

The people who start are the people who finish. Four to six weeks after completion we come back to look at every seam and edge, and the workmanship is guaranteed for twelve months.

[See the finish up close: seams, internal corners, edges and joins from our own installations](https://www.mrwallcover.com/details/)

By [Dorin Burcus](https://www.mrwallcover.com/about/#dorin), founder · Last updated 22 October 2026
